title: GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE misroutes choice names into short-ID errors
description:
For `GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE`, a model can legally answer with `text=Name`, and the prompt now explicitly says so. But if the model instead sends `choice="Black"`, the bridge parses that as an object ID before it looks at the pending action type, so the request falls into `shortIds.resolve()` and returns the raw error `Unknown short ID: Black`.

That error is misleading for a color/name picker and bypasses the structured `invalid_choice` path that would tell the model to use `text=Name` or `choice=N` with the available choices attached.

Evidence:
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g2/Gem3P Coach_llm.jsonl:16` shows the bridge prompting `Choose color` with `Respond: choice=0, choice=1, etc. or text=Name (not yes/no)`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g2/Gem3P Coach_llm.jsonl:18` shows `choose_action({"choice":"Black"})` returning `{"error": "Unknown short ID: Black"}`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g2/Gem3P Coach_pilot.log:44-50` shows the pilot treating it as a failed action, then recovering only after a second model call with `text="Black"`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g2/Gem3P Coach_mcp.log:32` logs the same raw MCP failure.

Source:
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/tools/ChooseActionTool.java:68-84` parses any non-numeric, non-yes/no `choice` as an `id`.
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:1598-1638` resolves that `id` via `shortIds.resolve(id)` before dispatching on `action.method()`.
- The correct `GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE` validation path with `text` handling and structured `invalid_choice` errors lives later at `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:1919-1979`, but this request never reaches it.

Suggested fix: defer interpretation of free-form `choice` strings until after the pending action type is known, or special-case `GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE` so non-numeric `choice` values return a structured `invalid_choice` response that says to use `text=Name` or `choice=N` and includes the current choices.
